Title: Hazard Pay (Expedition)
Description: Percy Ellwood is searching for valuable Ancient Artifacts from Garden of Genesis
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Name’s Doctor Percival Ellwood. Call me Percy. I’m a collector of sorts. And you’re just the sort of folk I’ve been waiting for.
InProgressResponse: Returning empty handed? Well, can’t say I blame you. Not everyone has the gumption to brave the unknown.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Smite my bones! You made it through! What did you find? I’ll sort and label everything, take them back to the institute in London once I escape this place.
ObjectiveOnCooldownResponse: Good work on that latest haul! After I get things appraised I'll have another task for you.

Title: Parted in Anger
Description: Speak to members of the Cult of Renewal to learn what happened to Han Fang's daughter, Han Liu.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: How embarrassing. Yes. This is all so personal, and you a total stranger, but my daughter Han Liu has vanished.
InProgressResponse: I know I ask a great deal of you, stranger. You have my family's gratitude. Please bring my daughter back to me.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: You return! Did they speak to you? I cannot fathom they would turn you away as well. You do not have that "hovering mother" look about you.

Title: The Cult of Renewal
Description: Find Han Liu by joining her on the Cult of Renewal's so-called "Path of Truth."
ObjectiveProposalResponse: They would. How like a cult to both prevent me from speaking to her after she was in their clutches and then immediately send her away to prove herself.
InProgressResponse: I only hope we are not too late.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: I cannot tell you what a relief it is to see another on the road. I was truly beginning to worry I would need to continue on alone!

Title: Walking Wyrds
Description: Complete your own Path of Truth by planting an imbued seed at each of the Angry Earth shrines within the Wyrdwood Twists. Help Han Liu do the same by clearing the path of Angry Earth.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: My mother? She truly cannot mind her own affairs, can she? This is MY choice. Those people were kind to me. All I want to do is learn more about them!
InProgressResponse: I can climb well enough, but I am afraid I am rather useless in a fight. I hope for both our sakes that you are equipped to handle this.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Forgive me for being so cryptic before. This trial is certainly not for the faint of heart, but it does help us find those who truly think and feel as we do.

Title: Spoken Wyrds
Description: Talk to Han Fang about taking the oath to officially join the Cult of Renewal.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: You have, but in deed only. I have seen your commitment to understanding what it is we are doing here and it has been noted.
InProgressResponse: The High Sage spoke those words to me when first we met. I felt them so stark, so prescient, that I saved them for all to come.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Welcome to the Cult of Renewal, my friend. I now name you Initiate, and soon all of our knowledge will be yours.

Title: A Sword in my Stead
Description: Try to talk Han Liu out of undergoing a difficult rite and help her succeed if she insists on going anyway.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: She mentioned yet another trial, this time to one of those dryad-infested towers! I need not remind you how utterly defenseless she is!
InProgressResponse: What on Aeternum is this cult after? It feels to me as if they are trying to get their followers killed. Oh Liu… why won't you listen?
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: What a triumph. In so little time both you and Miss Liu have not only demonstrated a willingness to learn, but also a deep, abiding respect for the denizens of Edengrove.

Title: One of Us
Description: Venture to Buggane Hedge and harvest herbs for a calming tea from the hides of dryads.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Like myself and the High Sage, and the scores of Exalted, they will have gained the deepest, most complete understanding of our way of life.
InProgressResponse: I find a calming tea helps center them, opens their mind to the experience they are about to have.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: This is a fine bundle of herbs. I hope you did not have a great deal of trouble acquiring them- it is a tricky task at best.

Title: Something to Celebrate
Description: Venture into the verdant forests of Edengrove to harvest colorful flowers in celebration of the returning cultists.
PlayerPrompt: "What happens if they do not return?"
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Ah… I would prefer not to darken the mood with that discussion. I will, but not now. In this moment I would like to assume they will succeed.
InProgressResponse: I find a nice flower wreathe to heighten any bright and cheerful moment. And their return shall be so!
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: You have a fine eye for color. Yes, these will do nicely. I will save the extras for another time, perhaps dry them. That seems appropriate.

Title: Waste Not, Want Not
Description: Retrieve the fallen belongings of cultists who have failed their final rite.
PlayerPrompt: "Is that it? They just… don't come back?"
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Not as themselves, no. They likely still linger in the forest in a more… lacking state. A soulless state, one could say.
InProgressResponse: Everything we do is to strengthen the cult. No one individual rises above that goal. Not even myself. Not even the High Sage.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: You went into the forest? Oh, this curiosity of mine is consuming! Tell me, tell me, what did you see? What happened to them?

Title: Where You Go, I Will Follow
Description: Help Han Fang reunite with Han Liu.
PlayerPrompt: "I do not think she will leave them."
ObjectiveProposalResponse: I think you are right. I have a terrible choice to make. I can continue to beg her to leave.
InProgressResponse: I hope she will hear me out, this time.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Why is my mother here? What did she say? I hope she does not mean to lecture me AGAIN.

Title: Medicinal Qualities
Description: Collect medicinal herbs from Lough Du Lac swamp to help Sai Khanam recover from her wounds.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Not unscathed, I'm afraid. They came while we were resting and upended everything. It seemed as though they were searching for something.
InProgressResponse: I am in no immediate danger, but I am in considerable pain. Any help you can offer is appreciated.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: You found them! What fine specimens. The soil here must be very fertile.

Title: Thieves in the Night
Description: Find and retrieve Sai Khanam's stolen belongings.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: It seems that way, doesn't it? I cannot fathom what I could have in my possession that would interest a dryad.
InProgressResponse: It was very dark when they came, but I believe they ran to the west of here, up the slope behind me. Thank you again for your aid.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Ah! You found them! And mostly intact, too. Did the wolf come with you?

Title: Here, Boy!
Description: Help Sai Khanam track down her wolf companion.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: After you left, he turned to me and simply plucked my bow out of my hands with his teeth!
InProgressResponse: We have not traveled together long, but already I cannot imagine going on without him. I hope this is not the end of our companionship.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Hello, human. I am afraid I cannot return my companion's bow to you.

Title: Scout's Big Secret
Description: Return to Sai Khanam and give her the totem Scout gave you.
PlayerPrompt: "I did not come for the bow."
ObjectiveProposalResponse: You are not? Ah… Sai must be worried about me. What a strange thing, to be bound to one of your kind. Our aims are so often opposed.
InProgressResponse: Please do not share the fact that I can speak with her. I will tell her, in my own time and my own way.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: He came back! And-- what is this carving? Did you make this? I will cherish this, as I cherish him. I suppose I should finally choose a name for him, eh?

Title: The Work You Undid
Description: Replant the medicinal herbs you stole to their proper place within Lough Du Lac.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: I suppose it would look like a swamp to one such as yourself. Damp, smells of mold, and rampant with life. Offensive to human noses, no doubt.
InProgressResponse: We have little to say to one another until you have completed the task at hand.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: I will say this about your kind; You are remarkably efficient.

Title: Waiting on the Wind
Description: Now that the wind is right, climb to the top of the bridge Avernal Verdure and burst the plant bulbs to release their pollen.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: I keep an aerial garden above the canopy, just east of here. You can find it atop a crumbling bridge.
InProgressResponse: You can use your feet to burst them, if it pleases you.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: I can see from the pollen on your boots that the deed is done. Soon all of Edengrove will become my garden. Here is your payment, human.

Title: Even Greater Heights
Description: Help Hedera expand her garden by climbing the ruins and planting a flower seed at its highest point.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: To the point. Efficient, as I said. There are ruins atop the rise to the north. It is one of the highest points in Edengrove.
InProgressResponse: Try not to fall. Your bones are fragile, I have heard.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: In time, the bloom will mature and the wind will carry its scent far and wide. It is a species I have cultivated from my own body. A point of pride for my kind.

Title: Hold Your Breath
Description: Destroy the strange flowers clinging to the rocks, ideally without breathing in their scent.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Let me… gather my thoughts. Just hold on. I had it. It was right there.
InProgressResponse: Do. Not. Smell. The. Flowers.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: How strange. They are gone, but the scent remains. Do you smell it? Are you afflicted too?!

Title: A Dark Compulsion
Description: Clear the path to the north and west to allow Ranger Yasin to pass unharmed to… wherever it is he is going.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: I know how it sounds. I hear myself. My feet will move me down this path either way. I can FEEL her, waiting. How do I know this? Sahal! Wake yourself!
InProgressResponse: It is taking every ounce of will I have to stay here. Please, clear the way.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Where is she? I am here! I saw it in my mind! Ranger, shake yourself out of it.

Title: Crying Out for Love
Description: Ascend the rise and light a bonfire to help signal Ranger Yasin's presence to his "love."
ObjectiveProposalResponse: I am speaking to you with all the sincerity in my heart. If I do not find her, I will die. I know it, like I know my own name. My heart will shatter in my chest.
InProgressResponse: She will see it, and she will come. She will see it, and she will come! She must…
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Move aside! Surely she must--

Title: Out of His Misery
Description: Speak to the dryad Hedera to find a way to rid Ranger Yasin of his affliction.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: My feet are bound to this spot as a tree is rooted to the earth. I can do nothing to change my fate… but you can.
InProgressResponse: I feel wretched. Like my heart is being rent from my chest. Please, hurry.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Ah. You lived. Thank you for dealing with that nuisance. I believe I owe you coin, as per your custom.

Title: The Pioneer's Lament
Description: Help a doomed farmer move on with his life.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Forgive me, I’ve made a horrible, horrible mistake. I tried to start a farm in Edengrove. I moved my family here. We were to harvest paradise. Fool!
InProgressResponse: Go to my farm, fight off the Angry Earth who have claimed it, and retrieve my farming equipment. And perhaps some token of my family. I am a broken, lonely man.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: You found my equipment, thank god. But what’s this? A letter from my son? He says he’s raising a farm in Ebonscale Reach, the brave, resourceful lad.

Title: Art is Suffering
Description: Deface an avant-garde sculptress's embarrassing early work.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Ahem. Like all great artists, I was in a state of deep meditation. Creativity means surrender, not control. It took me centuries to learn that.
InProgressResponse: Dispose of some poorly aged sculptures from my formative years.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: All gone? Thank the Muses! Someday I shall memorialize your deeds in marble.

Title: Heart Beats Hate
Description: Harvest the heart of Aeternum's angriest Dryad Brute, for science.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Ay, look at yon Dryad Brute. Just stares at that tower all day, seething. Fascinating. ‘Balor the Belligerent,’ I call him.
InProgressResponse: There’s a Dryad Brute called Balor the Belligerent. I need his heart. His beautiful, hate-filled heart. Kill him and bring it to me, if you would be so kind.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: You have the heart, do you? Very resourceful. Look at that, pumping rage and venom. Once I distill it I’ll be capable of the same.

Title: Wyldwood Water
Description: Find the Wyldwood Water recipe for Antara.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Hah. I only want to continue my mother's legacy. I want to find the potion she said would help us see the world as it really is.
InProgressResponse: Did you find the recipe? It should be in one of the chests on this bridge.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Wonderful! I can’t believe it. You found the recipe for Wyldwood Water! I wish my mother was here to see this.

Title: Everywhere Friends
Description: Understand the message Antara's mother wanted to convey through the Wyldwood Water.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Hah, clever! Yes, we can't really die on this island. And you seem to have enough spirit to keep from turning Lost.
InProgressResponse: How are you feeling? Do you notice anything different about the nature around you?
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: I'm glad you're here with me. I guess the universe works in strange ways and I'm lucky you came to the bridge when you did.

Title: Incomparable Blue
Description: Return the misplaced easel to Pietr Wolcott.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: (The painting has been signed by a P. Wolcott. Upon closer inspection, there's a note asking for it to be returned if found.)
InProgressResponse: (The painting has been signed by a P. Wolcott. Upon closer inspection, there's a note asking for it to be returned if found.)
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: What a gorgeous blue! It's so close to the shade I imagined.
